name: Moving keys
note: For climbing the key-change ladder: the warm-up is deliberately easier than the block that follows.

blocks.label: Settle in
blocks.note: One key while the voice wakes up.

blocks.label: One key
blocks.note: Let do settle before it starts moving.

blocks.label: Keys every 5
blocks.note: Find do again each time the key moves.

blocks.label: Keys every 2
blocks.note: The hard end. Expect the score to drop; that is the point.

blocks.label: Reverse it
blocks.note: Producing a degree in a key that keeps moving.
